## 3. DESCRIPTION (Final Public Copy — Plain Text)
Rain traces slow lines down the window as neon light spills into the room.
A CRT monitor flickers gently on the desk, terminal text scrolling while warm analog tones settle into a deep, locked-in rhythm. Outside is cold and distant — inside is calm, focused, and contained.
This 3-hour LoFi & Synthwave mix is designed for night coding, late study sessions, and deep focus after dark. Steady motion, restrained energy, and immersive atmosphere support long sessions without distraction.
